english: What's wrong, Houki?
I was wondering just what Key really is.
She knows the truth of the world, right?\nI wonder what that even means.
Maybe my senses went numb\nfrom too many strange things happening,\nbut I feel it now - this world is distorted.
Being able to hop between all those worlds\nis definitely weird.
Because of that, all those worlds got tangled up,\nand we almost started a war.
Mie's the one who wished\nfor such a world, probably.\nSince Key was following Mie.
Mie said she is the king of every world.\nShe also said she would rule them joyfully.
She's the maniac who'd challenge the Goddess of Destruction one-on-one -\na world ruled by power is probably\n'fun' to her.
But Mie has mentioned 'Mama'\nseveral times. There may be\nsomeone above her.
Like an alien?
She did say something like that.\nThat this place isn't a planet, but a spaceship.
Usada's memory is surprisingly good, nyu.
We still have no leads\non [CLAUDE]'s disappearance either.
I forgot!
Don't you dare forget!
Sorry, with everything going on, I just…\nKurumi, you remembered well!\nHave you been worried about him this whole time?
Of course! Even someone like him is,\nwell… one of us.\nBut if he betrayed us, I won't forgive him!
I'm also curious about what Polial is.\nIt doesn't look like Mie and Key\nmade it.
And Dokoka Town too.
Nobody scolded Dejiko for opening her shop,\nso Dejiko thinks it's a nice place, nyo.
But with no people around,\nand only things there…\nIt's a strange place, isn't it.
Like a shelter that was\nprepared in advance…
Exactly.\nEnemies can't reach us here - it's all a little too convenient.
Should we ask Juma Rin and Dorothy\nabout it in detail?
That might be good.\nWhether they'll answer is another matter.
Looks like we're sortieing before that.
Report from the observation room.\nIt seems Mie has appeared!
There she is!
It's Mie…
Talk about low energy!?
What happened, I wonder…?
Just out for a night stroll, haha…
You don't look like you're having fun at all…
I was told I'm not allowed to play.\nIt's not fun at all.
You killed Sensei, and now you talk about fun!?\nI won't let you say that, desu~!
You killed Sensei! It's way too late for that!
Being free and being ordered are different.\nBeing forced to do stuff isn't fun at all.
But I'll do it. Mama's word is absolute.\nMama is right and never wrong.
Ugh, that light is the same as Key's!
Looks like she's serious from the start!
Then we'll go all-out from the start too!
Yes! We're ready!
Low energy or high energy,\nyou're Eve's killer!\nI've got zero intention of holding back!
Beginning extermination work.
Mie won't hold back.\nThis is work, just a job.
An ambush here!?
Mie knows.\nWhen it's a massacre, you kill the weak ones first.
This isn't the usual brute force…?
You thought Mie was an idiot, didn't you.\nI wasn't doing it because it's boring.\nMie likes fun things.
Over here too!!
A king mustn't get serious.\nUnless I think of something fun,\neverything gets boring right away.
…I get it, a little.\nBoring days suck, right?
But Mie, you've got the important part wrong.
What's wrong?
Fun things\naren't something you come up with alone.
Really…?
Ever since I started this journey with everyone,\nI haven't been bored at all.\nEvery day's fun - it's the best!
Hmm… but Mama decided I'm killing all of you.\nToo bad.
Picking a fight with that Mama of yours\nsounds fun too, y'know!
That's… not happening.
Mie is definitely taking damage!
About as strong as Key… we can win this!
Didn't Mie tell you?\nThis is just work.
For 'just work,' you're getting cornered pretty hard!
Idiots should keep their mouths shut.
What'd you say!?
Sheesh, I hate this… but if I don't do it right\nI'll get scolded…
Hm!? Careful! She's up to something!
I'm just doing it properly. Properly.
What!?\nHer energy signature is nothing like Key's!?
Kee-chan started enjoying killing\nin extermination mode, but\nMie's different.
That was Mie's extermination mode.\nThis is work mode.\nIt's even more boring.
Kyaa!?
What is this!? Is this Mie's power!?
Everyone's going to die even if Mie does nothing.
What an ability…!!
Tachibana!
I know!\nThe only way to survive is to take her down!
You're not saying we should talk it out?
Not now…!
Today's club meeting looks like it'll be\na no-holds-barred survival battle!
Will the winner get\na big present, I wonder? I wonder?
Oh my, Rena, don't you know?\nThere's a present called 'the future'.
Quite the quote, Satoko!
And the future is something\neveryone can share. Nipa~☆
There's no future.\nMama won't give you that.
Handouts are never any good, nyo!\nThe starting gear a king gives you in an RPG\nis always junk, nyo!
Apologize to the Copper Sword, nyu.
This is getting bad.
Hasn't it been that way for a while now?
I gave up long ago.\nNo matter what happens, Miss Valliere\nwill never say she'll run.
You understand me well, Siesta!
Shirayuki, how long can you keep us going with healing?
Don't expect too much.\nMore importantly, Aria, how fast can you take that thing down?
Don't know. But I'll definitely take her down!\nShe's the one holding Riko's rosary!
Twin Angel never loses!
I'll protect everyone, no matter what!
Angel Rush, let's go!
Right here!\nCome on, super heroines!
Let's settle this!!
Why…?\nMama… why did Mie lose?
Mama told me to exterminate them.\nIsn't what Mama decides absolute?
This is wrong… Mie's the king.\nWhy did I lose to inferior creatures?\nMama…!
Today's Mie didn't look like a king at all.
Uuuh… uwaaaaaaaaah!
Mamaa!!
She's gone…
Phew, that was close for us too.
We failed to finish her, but it couldn't be helped.
Mie…
Riko. This was lying on the ground.
Ah! Riko's rosary!!
I don't think it's the real one.
Let me see!
Yeah… it's real… Mother's rosary…
Did she drop it during the fight…?
Maybe she left it behind on purpose.
Who knows?
That's wonderful, Riko!
Thank you…
…Now, if I can just beat Ormes…
…You're doing it?
Ormes…!
…Not now.
I mean, the showdown with Ormes is\nthe main event~.\nIf I do it now it'd just be the opening act!
Right. There are things we need to do first.
It's on hold until then.\nBut don't think I'm going soft!
That's my line!
Phew… I thought\na battle was about to start.
Starting a fistfight right after a battle like that\nwould be genuinely idiotic!
What a relief…\nIs this thanks to Mie?
No way!
If only Mie and Key\nwould quiet down now.
Then what would happen?
If [CLAUDE] came back,\nwould it be happily ever after?
I doubt it ends that neatly.
The fighting's settled down for now,\nso how about we look into Dokoka Town?
The tired ones can rest - not a bad plan.
Agreed!
